title: List other browsers' bookmarks
description: List the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Safari profiles on this computer whose bookmarks can be imported into the DSphere browser, with an opaque source ID, the profile name, a status and the bookmark count. The Native Agent finds them for the current user; no path is returned.
guidance: Pass the source IDs of ready profiles to dsagent.bookmarks.import. Safari exists only on macOS and needs Full Disk Access for the DSphere browser (status access-denied until the person grants it). Fails with NATIVE_UNAVAILABLE when the Native Agent is not connected and NATIVE_UPGRADE_REQUIRED when it is too old to read bookmarks.

outputSchema.description: The profiles found, Chrome first, then Edge, then Safari.

items.description: One browser profile on this computer whose bookmarks can be imported.

sourceId.description: An opaque source ID from dsagent.bookmarks.sources: the browser name, a dash and 16 hex digits. It never contains a path.

browser.description: The browser the profile belongs to: Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge or Safari (macOS only).

profile.description: The name the person gave the browser profile.

status.description: ready: can be imported; access-denied: the operating system refused (Safari needs Full Disk Access for the DSphere browser, which only the person can grant); unreadable: missing or malformed.

bookmarkCount.description: How many bookmarks (not folders) the profile has; 0 unless status is ready.
